details.label: Summary
details.text: Severe Thunderstorm Watch 603 will expire at 11z, and a new watch is not expected

details.label: Discussion
details.text: Widespread thunderstorms and stratiform precipitation continue across portions of western and Middle Tennessee at 1020z. Substantial convective overturning and weakening low-level warm advection have led to generally diminished intensities over most of the remaining watch area since 09z. Although an occasionally stronger storm will remain possible over the next 1-2 hours over western and Middle TN in proximity to a modestly veering low-level jet, current and expected short-term convective trends should preclude the need for a new watch

details.label: Most probable threats
details.text: MOST PROBABLE PEAK WIND GUST...UP TO 60 MPH · MOST PROBABLE PEAK HAIL SIZE...UP TO 1.25 IN
